direct_official_checks: HMLR geometry is indicative and candidate identity must bind through canonical descriptor
HMLR polygon identity must be deduplicated across local-authority files
EA primary elevation must come from DTM rather than DSM
EA NoData sentinel must be rejected as numeric elevation
survey date transformation and geoid metadata must accompany timestamp evidence
EA ground-truth accuracy is QA evidence rather than parcel elevation accuracy
OS Terrain50 is coarse independent terrain corroboration rather than parcel-resolution truth
final candidate confidence requires separate treatment of geometry terrain geodesy and correlation uncertainties
quality_effect: Consolidates all source-specific accuracy gates into one fail-closed three-candidate production acceptance path.
